    The dual bridge: no dual tiny point #

    A dual tiny point of the ray category of B (a tiny point of its opposite) gives the data of not_minimal_of_tiny for the opposite algebra Bᵐᵒᵖ, which is also minimal representation-infinite (isMinimalRepInfinite_mop).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.SplitBasicData.not_tinyAtDual {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [FiniteDimensional k B] {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicData k B ι) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.toIdempotents.ProjectiveCategory] (hB : IsMinimalRepInfinite B) {X Z Bp : S.toIdempotents.RayCategory} (s : Z ⟶ X) (t : Bp ⟶ X) :
    ¬RayCat.TinyAtDual s t

    No dual tiny point in the ray category of a minimal representation-infinite algebra.
